description: This file is a shell script that defines a sequence of automated tests for the 'git submodule' command, specifically testing the 'summary' subcommand under various scenarios such as adding, updating, deinitializing, and changing submodule paths.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs specified shell commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified directory with a given message and content.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal test clock to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and reports if they differ.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given file or output is empty.

calls: test_commit -C sm "add file" file file-content file-tag
